prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent illustration for a mobile-first maker-club website hero. Create one exceptionally well-composed handmade PAPER-CUT MAKER WORKSHOP, inspired by the attached club bear and existing paper illustration style. Use the split tan-and-white bear with navy outlines and mustard apron from reference 2 faithfully, sitting centrally behind a wide substantial wooden workbench with both paws visibly resting on the tabletop, smiling with a curious expression. The bear head is prominent, at least 25% of scene width. On the table are a tiny birdhouse being made, scissors and thread, sensibly placed to the sides. Behind this is a simple rustic wooden display crossbar on two vertical supports: an EMPTY small hook at upper left for a separate strawberry bag image that the website will overlay, and TWO EMPTY clothespins at upper right for a separate square rug image that the website will overlay. Reserve empty transparent hanging spaces below those hooks at x10–35% and x67–95%, y16–55%; the central bear at x40–65%, y35–65%. Tabletop near y65%, legs fully visible down to92%, scene fully contained with breathing space. No blank photo frames. No trees, no garden arch, no floating stars, no backdrop shape, no paper sheet, no circle, no UI, no lettering. Warm natural wood cut from matte paper, restrained olive/sage accents and cream, ink navy, subtle paper fibres, clean flat shapes with small real cut-paper shadows. Match the supplied reference style, not glossy 3D, not watercolor, not gradients. Entire standalone maker-workshop silhouette with genuinely transparent background; hooks and all legs fully inside image. Width-to-height about1.2:1, visual clarity at360px wide. The layout should read as one physical workshop with believable supports, not a collection of stickers.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a continuous tall GROUND layer for a layered mobile woodland scene; people, large trees and workstations will be separate foreground assets. Paint an exceptionally art-directed long vertical meandering forest floor in muted cut-paper collage. Landscape seen obliquely from above, flat matte textured papers, hand-cut organic shapes in desaturated sage, moss, straw cream, navy-green, ochre and warm earth. A quiet narrow dirt footpath begins near upper center, meanders naturally through THREE irregular open clearings, branches subtly toward the left upper clearing, left middle clearing and right lower clearing, and exits lower center. Paths have irregular soft broken edges blending into leaf litter, with NO dark outline, NO perfect sinusoidal ribbon, NO road markings. Ground includes tufts of grass, scattered acorns, flat rocks, seed pods, fallen leaves, small asymmetrical moss patches and a few clustered wildflowers; small fine details distributed with intention, no bare featureless large areas and no dense horizontal hedges. Keep the upper left, middle left and lower right working areas fairly open for separate workshop artwork. A tiny shallow winding stream runs across one small part of the lower middle at an oblique angle, with earth banks and stepping stones crossing it; no wooden bridge. IMPORTANT: Only ground and small ground details, NO trees, NO bears, NO people, NO benches, NO cabins, NO big plants, NO lettering, NO frames. One uninterrupted natural environment, no horizontal scene divisions or borders. Top and bottom gently irregular cut-paper silhouette with REAL TRANSPARENCY beyond it, and small foliage/grass tips breaking those edges. The main ground is opaque sage paper, not washed out. Tall vertical aspect ratio roughly1:3. Match the paper texture and flat muted colours of the supplied reference, keep material beautiful at phone size, avoid photorealism, glossy 3D, gradients and noisy airbrush shading.
